description: Move duplicated Petri net transition exhaustion and guarded loop-breaker assertion helpers from pkg/config/maptests and pkg/replay/configtests into pkg/testutil, retarget call sites, and delete local copies without changing which transitions, guards, or places each test verifies.

context.customerAsk: Consolidate duplicated Petri transition assertion helpers (no TransitionExhaustion, guarded loop-breaker VisitCountGuard wiring) from maptests and replay/configtests into pkg/testutil as part of backend pkg/ duplication cleanup.
context.problem: assertNoTransitionExhaustion/assertGuardedLoopBreakerTransition in maptests and assertReplayHasNoTransitionExhaustion/assertReplayGuardedLoopBreakerTransition in replay/configtests are near-identical copies that differ only in failure-message wording and minor guard formatting, increasing drift risk during Petri mapping test maintenance.
context.solution: Add exported AssertNoTransitionExhaustion and AssertGuardedLoopBreakerTransition helpers in pkg/testutil with a small options value for exhaustion-context phrasing, migrate both test packages to import them, delete local helpers, and verify with go test ./pkg/config/maptests/... and go test ./pkg/replay/configtests/... without changing production mapper or replay behavior.

acceptanceCriteria: Exactly one implementation of AssertNoTransitionExhaustion and AssertGuardedLoopBreakerTransition lives under pkg/testutil
pkg/config/maptests and pkg/replay/configtests import the shared helpers and contain no duplicate local exhaustion or loop-breaker assertion definitions
Existing test expectations are unchanged: same transitions, guard transition/workstation IDs, max-visit counts, and place IDs at each call site
Maptests exhaustion failures still use customer-authored mapping context; replay exhaustion failures still use replay-mapped customer config context
go test ./pkg/config/maptests/... and go test ./pkg/replay/configtests/... pass
Typecheck, lint, and tests pass for all touched backend areas

userStories.title: Shared Petri transition assertion helpers in testutil
userStories.description: As a backend maintainer, I want shared Petri transition assertion helpers in pkg/testutil so exhaustion and loop-breaker checks are defined once and reused across mapping and replay tests.
acceptanceCriteria: AssertNoTransitionExhaustion(t, transitions, opts) fails on TransitionExhaustion transitions and embeds opts.ExhaustionContext (or equivalent) in the fatal message

AssertGuardedLoopBreakerTransition(t, transition, inputPlace, outputPlace, watchedTransitionID, maxVisits) asserts normal type, single input/output arcs, VisitCountGuard transition ID and max visits, and expected place IDs
Both helpers call t.Helper() and live in pkg/testutil (assertions.go or petriassert.go in the same package)
Typecheck passes
